hypothesis: After a training-defined volatility-compression state, a completed Donchian breakout that retests and reclaims the broken boundary, with BTC trend confirmation, may have positive net expectancy. Evaluate each symbol and context independently; do not pool symbols for promotion.

features.donchian: Prior N completed bars; exclude the current signal bar.
features.compression: ATR14/close on the completed bar immediately before breakout <= symbol-specific training-only q33.
features.trend: EMA50/EMA200 non-flat using the symbol-specific training-only flat-spread threshold; direction is the spread sign.
features.btcConfirmation: BTC EMA50/EMA200 non-flat and same direction at retest confirmation close.
features.shock: Exclude if absolute completed 4h close-to-close log return exceeds symbol training q99.

rules.breakoutLong: Completed 4h close > prior N-bar highest high after preceding bar met compression condition.
rules.breakoutShort: Completed 4h close < prior N-bar lowest low after preceding bar met compression condition.
rules.retestLong: Within next 1-3 completed bars, low touches breakout level within 0.2*ATR14 and close reclaims above; BTC trend UP.
rules.retestShort: Within next 1-3 completed bars, high touches breakout level within 0.2*ATR14 and close reclaims below; BTC trend DOWN.
rules.entry: Next 4h bar open after retest confirmation; no same-bar fill.
rules.stop: Retest swing low - 0.25*ATR14 for long; retest swing high + 0.25*ATR14 for short.
rules.intrabar: Stop-first when both stop and target touch; adverse gap-through fills at bar open; conservative target gap fill.
rules.sizing: Risk-normalized 1R per trade; one position per symbol; no compounding.

validation.splits: Chronological 60% train / 20% validation / 20% untouched test; 12-bar purge/embargo.
validation.walkForward: At least 3 anchored walk-forward test windows plus final frozen untouched test.

costs.spreadSlippage: Historical calibration required; 15bp is only a proxy.

validation.multipleTesting: Holm correction across the three predeclared Donchian lookbacks per symbol/context.

evidenceGates.bootstrap95CILowerBound: strictly above zero using serial-dependence-aware block bootstrap
evidenceGates.walkForward: positive net expectancy in at least 3 independent windows
evidenceGates.parameterStability: no sign reversal or severe degradation across neighboring lookbacks

noTrade: stale contract metadata for execution validation
unpriced funding or uncalibrated cost model
spread above 10 bps or inadequate depth
knownFailureModes: Breakout continuation may fail in persistent low-volatility ranges.
Retests can be shallow or missed, creating fill-model sensitivity.
BTC confirmation can lag or reverse during alt-specific shocks.
Funding and spread costs can erase small gross edges.
Three-lookback search creates data-snooping risk; Holm correction and untouched test are mandatory.
